{{Top|leg}}
A '''thal''' was a shrine important to [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] religion. It was a constructed of black polished [[Stone/Legends|stone]] and stood at the center of every urban area and clan-city on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. Thals were forbidden to be constructed off-[[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>
